flask_app.py — web routes and analysis¶

Location: module_4/src/flask_app.py. The module exposes app as its Flask application. Run python -m module_4.src.flask_app from the repository root.

Route contract¶

Method and path

Function

Response and behavior

GET / or /analysis

index()

Render fresh analysis with HTTP 200; return an error page with HTTP 500 on a SQLAlchemy database error.

POST /pull-data

pull_data()

Start the worker and render the page; reject a concurrent pull with HTTP 409. Rendering can return HTTP 500 if the database is unavailable.

GET /pull-status

pull_status_endpoint()

Return status JSON with HTTP 200.

POST /update-analysis

update_analysis()

Render refreshed results; return HTTP 409 while a pull is running or HTTP 500 if analysis fails.

Status JSON contains state, title, message, started_at, finished_at, and summary. States are idle, running, success, and error. Completed-pull summaries contain loader row counts. The default run_pull_pipeline() raises NotImplementedError in Module 4; its worker records the error in status. Tests replace that hook with deterministic data.

Display live PostgreSQL analysis results in a Flask webpage.
